passages.question: When is the 2026 Form 940 due?
passages.excerpt: The due date for filing Form 940 for 2025 is February 2, 2026. However, if you deposited all your FUTA tax when it was due, you may file Form 940 by February 10, 2026. ... If any due date for filing falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday, you may file your return on the next business day.

passages.question: Which state goes on line 1a?
passages.excerpt: 1a. One state only. Enter the two-letter USPS abbreviation for the state where you were required to pay your state unemployment tax on line 1a. ... 1b. More than one state (you're a multi-state employer). Check the box on line 1b. Then, fill out Schedule A (Form 940).

passages.question: What goes in line 3, total payments to all employees?
passages.excerpt: Report the total payments you made during the calendar year on line 3. Include payments for the services of all employees, even if the payments aren't taxable for FUTA. ... Compensation, such as the following. Salaries, wages, commissions, fees, bonuses, vacation allowances, and amounts you paid to full-time, part-time, or temporary employees.
